subject: Image scanner cadence, SLA for high-severity CVEs, and evidence digest request
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@finco.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: AuditOps Team <auditops@finco.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Image scanner cadence, 72-hr SLA for high-severity CVEs, and evidence ask

Hi Markus,

Thanks for taking this request. As part of FinCo's SIG review and SOC 2 readiness we need a short packet showing:

- Current container/image scanning cadence across your hosted and private deployments (how often images are scanned, difference between base OS images vs app images).
- Your stated SLA for triage/remediation of high-severity (CVSS >= 9.0) container/image CVEs and a sample of recent closures.
- Evidence that scans were performed against the exact images we rely on: we will provide two image digests (sha256:aa11... and sha256:bb22...) to match against your logs.

Ideally we need: a CSV of scan schedule, a closure log (PDF acceptable), and a short addendum we can sign to confirm a 72-hour remediation SLA for critical findings in images used in our production tenancy. Can you confirm what you can deliver and by when? We are targeting our SIG submission on July 7.

Appreciate a short answer — if you need me to loop in procurement or legal for an SLA addendum, say the word.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Security Evidence Lead, FinCo
auditops@finco.com

Hi Samir — thanks for the clear list. We can produce the packet you described. Quick snapshot of next steps and deliverables:

1) Scan cadence CSV (what scans run where + responsible team): will attach image-scan-schedule-2027Q3.csv.
2) Closure log for high-severity image CVEs: we'll provide cve-closure-log-20270630.pdf with a per-CVE timestamp and owner.
3) Proof-of-scan for the two image digests you listed: we'll include the raw scan rows from our image scanner (sha256 hash, scan timestamp, findings summary).
4) Draft SLA addendum (PDF) for a 72-hour triage/mitigation commitment for CVSS >= 9.0 on images used in your tenancy — we can provide a DocuSign envelope if you want a legally-signed addendum.

Target delivery: EOD (PST) today for the CSV and scan rows; SLA draft and closure log by EOD tomorrow. If that timeline works, Kimberly and Monica will assemble the artifacts and upload to the secure link below.

Subject: Re: Image scanner cadence, 72-hr SLA for high-severity CVEs, and evidence ask

Samir / Markus — attaching the initial artifacts. Quick notes:

- image-scan-schedule-2027Q3.csv: shows cadence by image class. Base infra images (monthly full scans + daily vuln delta) vs application images (CI-integrated scan on every push + weekly full scan).
- 20270614-image-scan-snapshot.csv: example of a raw scan output for the image registry; includes the sha256 digests you provided (we matched both).
- cve-closure-log-20270630.pdf: redacted closure log for high severity items; entries show ticket id, CVE, initial detection, assignment, and mitigation timestamp.
- high-sev-sla-addendum-draft.pdf: short (1 page) draft SLA for 72-hour triage + mitigation timeframe for critical image CVEs. This is intentionally narrowly scoped to images used in customer-tenanted deployments; it references compensating controls (runtime integrity checks, emergency hotpatching windows, and automated rollback).

Two clarifications:
1) For supply-chain-origin CVEs that require vendor patching (e.g., base-image vendor has to release a patch), our operational workflow includes an interim mitigation plan (pinning, rebuild from fixed base, or compensating runtime mitigation). Those will be documented in the closure log per CVE.
2) The 72-hour SLA is workable as an operational commitment; legal will need to review any billing/credits language. We marked the draft as "technical SLA" for now. If you want a customer-facing contract, we can route it to Legal/Procurement.

Let us know if you want the DocuSign envelope — I can prepare the routing.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Vulnerability Management
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

- Can you add a single-line mapping in the CSV that shows which internal team owns remediation for image vs infra findings (we need a named owner for our SIG questionnaire).
- Please mark the SLA draft as either "Technical Commitment" or "Contractual Addendum" and include a DocuSign link if you have one ready.

If you can push those by EOD Friday (your timezone) we should be able to include them in the SIG/CAIQ upload. Happy to sign the technical commitment and then have procurement pull a legal addendum if needed.
